svg.aria-label: Taylor Dolezal, Head of Open Source at Dosu, in Los Angeles. Building open source communities, making useful things, and sharing what I learn. Career so far: Disney Studios (Lead SRE), HashiCorp (Developer Advocate), CNCF (Head of Ecosystem), Dosu (Head of Open Source). Alongside: Kubernetes 1.19 lead, SIG Docs tech lead, KubeCon keynoter. The project is code. The work is people.
